why_no_runtime_port: Legacy T-018 SyncContext owns file-spool paths and imports foreign-origin batches; it is not an implementation of the current SyncTransport.send_event outbound protocol.
SQLiteStateStore.import_verified_events is an offline migration API restricted to replacing a fresh genesis, not an incremental inbound API.
Current last_ack_cursor tracks outbound acknowledgements; using it for inbound peer checkpoints would conflate directions and peers.

T-018 contract explicitly leaves initial trusted cursor unresolved and says not to add replacement auth; the other branch has a candidate HMAC gate requiring an independent rollback anchor, so the contracts cannot be silently combined.

Legacy inbound import calls StateStore.emit once per event before cursor commit and does not prove all-or-none batch atomicity. Copying it into SQLite as-is would risk partial-prefix acceptance or split state/cursor commits.
required_port_contract: Keep the existing phone state authority; inbound accepted data must be written as local sync.received envelopes, never by replacing remote records in the local hash chain.
Add per-peer inbound checkpoint/dedup/conflict state to SQLite, distinct from the outbound outbox cursor.
Validate and apply the entire batch plus inbound checkpoint in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with rollback at every failure point.
Define bootstrap trust for first-time peer checkpoints and the authorized authentication model before coding.
Handle crash between SQLite commit and any independent anti-rollback anchor update with idempotent recovery semantics.
Implement quarantined malformed/conflicting batches without treating rejection audit events as accepted remote effects.
next_gate: Owner/policy decision required for inbound authentication/trusted checkpoint semantics; after that implement an SQLite-native import boundary and crash/replay tests before any source ref pruning.
